pages.title: Finding Orichalcum
pages.text: Default deposits: Overworld, Y 0 to 128. Veins target up to 6 blocks, with 5 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 4.

pages.title: Working Orichalcum
pages.text: Smelt Orichalcum Ore or Orichalcum Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 1350 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 4.$(br)Mining efficiency: 7.7.$(br)Material damage bonus: 6.2.$(br)Enchantability: 20.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 4, chestplate 7, leggings 6, boots 2.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 1.5.$(br)Enchantability: 14.

pages.title: Equipment: Champion
pages.text: Killing monsters restores durability to Orichalcum Items (Amount is equal to the max health of the killed monster)

pages.title: Armor: Berserker
pages.text: Killing a mob grants a strength buff, level of which is equal to the count of every other remaining hostile mob around the wearer. (Max Potion Level: 6) (Armor scales the radius and duration of the bonus)
